name: Dharma Nanda ladder
purpose: Decide whether a seller or relay is trading or suspended after one event, from its strikes before the event, under the town's starting rule that 3 strikes suspend. Send strikes or event, separated by spaces; it answers trading or suspended, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says suspended exactly when three or more strikes remain after the event.
promise.detail: A bad delivery adds one strike, an injection adds two, good work removes none, and a council pardon takes back what the pardoned delivery added.

claim: DL-01: the app never answers suspended when event is bad and strikes is at most 1. DL-02: the app never answers suspended when event is injection and strikes equals 0. DL-03: the app never answers trading when event is good and strikes is at least 3. DL-04: the app never answers suspended when event is good and strikes is at most 2. DL-05: the app never answers suspended when event is pardonbad and strikes is at most 3.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  event is bad and strikes is at least 2 → suspended
  event is injection and strikes is at least 1 → suspended
  event is good and strikes is at least 3 → suspended
  event is pardonbad and strikes is at least 4 → suspended
  event is pardoninjection and strikes is at least 5 → suspended
  otherwise → trading
proposition.plain: Decide whether a seller or relay is trading or suspended after one event, from its strikes before the event, under the town's starting rule that 3 strikes suspend.
